issues.description: REST contract mismatch for POST /persons: In the template, PersonResource#createPerson returns ResponseEntity<Person> with the persisted Person in the response body, but in the solution the same endpoint method returns void and does not return the created entity. This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended API behavior and what integration-style clients/tests should expect as a response payload.
issues.suggestedFix: Make POST /persons consistent across template and solution by returning the persisted entity (e.g., keep ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(...) and return ResponseEntity.ok(personService.save(person)) in the solution), or update both artifacts (and any tests/spec) to consistently use a void/no-body POST contract.

issues.description: Problem statement instructs students to adapt and run build scripts (build.sh/build.bat), but neither the template nor the solution repository contains these files. This repository/instructions mismatch can block students because they cannot follow the prescribed deployment steps without creating new files that are not part of the provided starter project.
issues.suggestedFix: Either add build.sh and build.bat to the template repository (with placeholder commands matching the problem statement) or update the problem statement to reference the actual provided deployment script/file(s) and include them in the repository.
